payload.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-06-26T00:00:00Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T11:08:28Z"
        AND host.name == "db-1"
        AND event.outcome == "failure"
        AND message LIKE "*Failed password*"
| STATS failed_count = COUNT(*)
        BY hour_of_day = DATE_TRUNC(1 hour, @timestamp)
| SORT hour_of_day ASC

questions.q: In the row where hour_of_day is '2026-07-26T09:00:00.000Z', what is the value of failed_count?
How many rows does this payload contain?
Which hour_of_day has the largest failed_count?
